simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to צָאָה (H6627) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: n-f.
simple.whyItMatters: This word appears 2 times in the Hebrew Bible, so BibleIQ can compare how Scripture uses it across multiple passages.
simple.summary: צָאָה (tsâʼâh) means issue , i.e. (human) excrement First listed occurrence: Deut 23 14.

definitions.full: H6627. tseah [ צֵאָה ] noun feminine filth , specifically human excrement ; — suffix צֵאָתֶ֑ךָ Deut 23:14 ; construct הָאָדָם צֵאַת בְּגֶלְלֵי Ezek 4:12 (as fuel; compare [ גֵּל ] p. 165 above).
